description: This classic Southern Buttermilk Fried Chicken delivers an unbeatable combination of crispy, golden-brown skin and incredibly juicy, tender meat. Marinated in buttermilk, each piece is bursting with flavor, creating a truly authentic taste of the American South. It is the ultimate comfort food, perfect for family gatherings or a satisfying weeknight meal.

ingredients.notes: a mix of drumsticks, thighs, and breasts

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the chicken pieces dry with paper towels. In a large bowl or resealable bag, combine the chicken and buttermilk. Ensure all chicken is submerged. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to tenderize and flavor the meat.

instructions.title: Prepare the Dredging Mixture
instructions.text: In a large, shallow dish or sturdy resealable bag, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, black pepper, and salt. Make sure the spices are evenly distributed throughout the flour.

instructions.title: Dredge the Chicken
instructions.text: Remove chicken pieces from the buttermilk, allowing excess to drip off. Do not rinse. One piece at a time, dredge the chicken thoroughly in the flour mixture, pressing firmly to ensure a thick, even coating. Place coated chicken on a wire rack set over a baking sheet to rest for 15-20 minutes. This helps the coating adhere better.

instructions.title: Heat the Frying Oil
instructions.text: Pour the vegetable or peanut oil into a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, filling it about 2-3 inches deep. Heat the oil over medium-high heat until it reaches 325-350°F (160-175°C). Use a thermometer to monitor the temperature for best results.

instructions.title: Fry the Chicken
instructions.text: Carefully place 2-3 pieces of chicken into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for about 6-8 minutes per side, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through. Breasts may take longer, about 10-12 minutes per side. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C).

instructions.title: Drain and Serve
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the fried chicken from the oil and place it on a clean wire rack set over paper towels to drain excess oil. Season immediately with a sprinkle of extra salt if desired. Let rest for a few minutes before serving hot. Repeat with remaining chicken pieces, ensuring oil temperature is maintained.

tips: For the crispiest skin, ensure the oil temperature stays consistent. If it drops too low, the chicken will be greasy; too high and it will burn on the outside before cooking through.
Do not skip the resting time for the dredged chicken. This crucial step allows the flour coating to absorb moisture and stick better, preventing it from falling off during frying.
Serve your Southern Buttermilk Fried Chicken with classic sides like mashed potatoes, collard greens, mac and cheese, or a fresh coleslaw for a complete meal.
